title: Guessing About Then: The Conditional
goal: Use the conditional to guess about a moment in the past, and tell it apart from the conditional that needs a condition.
grammar: The conditional for guesses about the past

items: I can use the conditional to guess about a moment in the past, as in serían las diez.
I can choose between the future and the conditional by the time I am talking about.
I can use the new words for looking back.
